newsitem.title: USA: Compare Generiks sees revs over $1.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Compare Generiks sees revs over $1.2 mln.

text.p: Compare Generiks Inc said Wednesday that it expects annual revenues to exceed $1.2 million in relation to a recent distribution agreement.

The company said in a release that it reached a distribution agreement for its free-standing rapid relief center display with the National Distribution Network, a buying cooperative for convenience store wholesalers.
Compare Generiks said the initial distribution would begin in February 1997 with a placement of about 5,000 free-standing displays.
